name: Kouyoku Senki ExS-Tia Concerto finale
original_name: 光翼戦姫エクスティアコンチェルト フィナーレ
source:
Kanon and Chiaki fend off an attack from invaders from another world.
At the same time, Haruno and Fuyuka, who had been missing, return.

As the invasion from the other world intensifies, the four heroines cooperate to confront multiple enemies.

However, in the midst of the battle, a mysterious Extear appears and engages in a fierce fight with Haruno and the others.
After barely managing to win, they find a young girl named "Shigure" who has lost her memories.

Help Shigure regain her memories through your interactions with her,
and stand up against the endless invasion from the other world!
translation:
加隆和千秋抵御来自异世界的入侵者的攻击。
与此同时，失踪的春野和冬香回来了。

随着异世界的入侵愈演愈烈，四位女主角联手对抗多重敌人。

然而，在战斗中，神秘的埃提尔出现，并与春野等人展开了激烈的战斗。
勉强获胜后，他们发现了一个名叫“时雨”的失去记忆的年轻女孩。

通过与时雨的互动，帮助她恢复记忆，
并勇敢地面对来自异世界的无尽入侵！
